lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Behemoth's egg is up ahead.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: But I don't see Leviathan anywhere.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: It must be a trap.
Let's not approach it for now and hold back.

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Hmph, you cowards! I'm going in!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: There's something inside.
Staring more closely at the egg, it's hard to see clearly,
but it appears to be filled with some kind of embryonic fluid, and floating inside...
Is the silhouette of a person.
Must be Behemoth.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's her all right. I recognize that outline.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: How has she gotten so big so quickly? How many Raptures has Leviathan been feeding her?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I think Leviathan may have fed herself to Behemoth.

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: When Nihilister was inside the Ark, she revived Indivilia and Chatterbox by feeding them parts of her own body.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If sustenance is what Behemoth requires, then using another Heretic's body would be the optimal choice.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Although it's hard to say how much she's ingested, or how much is required...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Let's keep our distance, and then try throwing a rock at it!

lines.speaker: maxwell_op
lines.text: Oooh, what do you think, Rapi?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I think I should stop trying to reason with you all...
*Bang*!
Something falls from the sky and lands with a resounding crash. The impact is strong enough to send vibrations all around.
As the dust clears, someone can be seen sprawled on the ground.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: So much for making a grand entrance...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Ow... my nose is killing me...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Gah! My nose is bleeding!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Who are you?!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: What do you mean? You know who I am...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? You're not Leviathan.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: One of the Four Beasts!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Strange. I came here because I sensed something familiar.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Do we know each other?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Sorry, my memory isn't so great.
Hasn't Leviathan told you?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... no?
We're new friends of hers.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, no kidding! No wonder.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Gosh, Leviathan never tells me anything.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Did she say anything about me?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Did she say I was good?
Er... sorry, but she only told us about Behemoth.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Maybe she forgot about me... yeah.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, just so you know!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: The reason Leviathan forgot to mention me isn't because I'm weak or anything, okay?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: She's smart, but sometimes she forgets to mention important details.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: It's a bit embarrassing having to do this myself, but in any case,

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: allow me to introduce myself.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: My name's Ziz. Got it?
Nice to meet you, Ziz. I'm {AccountData.NickName}.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}... All right, I won't forget it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm Rapi. Leviathan and I are old friends.
Rapi, don't start making up any weird backstories.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sorry, it didn't sound that outlandish in my head.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Rapi... Rapi...

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I'm Laplace!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: *Gasp*!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, sorry. Th-that was because I saw a bug on my arm.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: It's not because your voice was loud and startled me, all right?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Er... okay.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Laplace... Laplace...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: AND I'M DR...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Um... and I'm Drake.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Drake... Drake...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Nice to meet you, friends.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hehe. This is my first time making new friends outside of Leviathan, Behemoth, and Bahamut.
Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Are you here to see Leviathan?
Yeah. It's been a while since we saw her, so we came to chat.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Now who's creating weird backstories?
... Sorry. It sounded better in my head.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Okay, gotcha! But where is she?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: She's usually here.
Um... she went to get me some medicine for my upset stomach.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, what did I just tell you?
I can't help it!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh. Does your stomach hurt?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hold on. Let me see if I have some medicine.
*Whooshh*!
Ziz's wings unfurl, revealing a massive wingspan.
The wings appear to have a slimy texture reminiscent of Dark Matter.
Ziz reaches into her wings and starts rummaging around.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Here it is.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Take this. It'll make you feel better.
Oh... thanks.
Ziz hands over a glass bottle dripping with Dark Matter.
The moment I reach out to grab it, Ziz suddenly pulls it back.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Um... I'm not trying to take credit or anything,

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: but make sure to tell Leviathan I was the one who gave this to you, okay?
Uh... sure. I'll let her know how kind and thoughtful you are.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Kind and thoughtful?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hehe, you don't have to go that far.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Still... I'm sure it'd make her happy to hear that.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Anyway, I hope you feel better.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh hey, it's Leviathan.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hey, Leviathan!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I met your friends!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: What? I can't hear you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I said!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: They're enemies, you fool!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You tricked me!
Rapi!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Encount...!
Everything goes black.
The ground starts to shake violently.
Unable to maintain our balance, we all tumble to the ground.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Agh!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Oof! What's going on?!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: I-it's too dark! I hate the dark!
It's pitch black. I can't see two inches in front of my face.
My body continues to tumble about as I crash against various surfaces which I cannot see.
All I can hear are the screams of my friends all around me.
Just as my consciousness begins to fade, everything suddenly brightens again.
A blue sky, dotted with picturesque clouds, comes into view.
What the...?
Gaaaaahhhh!
I feel like I'm in freefall,
but how is that possible?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Ah-Ahhhhh—!!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: U-Ughhhh—!!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander!
The wind is hitting us so hard, that it's a struggle to even open my eyes.
Once I manage to pry them open,
I see that we're falling from an immeasurable height.
Wh-what's going on?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander! I'm coming!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Seven Dwarves Zero! Activate!
Seven Dwarves Zero's thrusters ignite.
While dizzyingly adjusting directions in mid-air, Rapi works her way towards me.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll catch you!
I curl up into the brace position,
and slam into Rapi's arms hard enough that it feels like ramming into a wall.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll try and land somewhere!
What about Laplace and Drake?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Those two can handle themselves.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Where do you think you're going?!
From afar, Ziz spreads her black wings and approaches us rapidly.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: helm_op_l
lines.text: Fire the anti-aircraft guns!

lines.speaker: mast_op_r
lines.text: Aye, aye, Captain!
Massive shells slam into Ziz as she approaches.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Urghhh!
Ziz is sent careening backwards through the air. At the same time, Rapi accelerates.
While holding me tightly against her, Rapi skids across the ground for a long distance before coming to a stop.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That was close.
Too close for comfort.
What about Laplace and Drake?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I told you, you've got nothing to worry about when it comes to those two.
Rapi points upwards towards the sky.
Like a pair of tandem skydivers, Laplace and Drake hold hands and spin in circles as they descend.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Woohoo! Heroic Tumble!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: No way, Villainous Tumble!
As they descend, the two suddenly let go of each other's hands,
and each lands dramatically in what they clearly think is their coolest pose.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Heroic Landing!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Villainous Entrance!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: To land from such an incredible height is a remarkable feat, even for a hero like me! How invigorating!
... At this point, I'm too tired to be amazed anymore.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Grryyyyaah!
Ziz dives straight at us from the air.
The fusillade of anti-aircraft fire from the Admire can't keep up with her speed.

lines.speaker: mast_op_r
lines.text: Dang, she's too fast!

lines.speaker: helm_op_l
lines.text: Tell the systems to lead the target, then!

lines.speaker: mast_op_r
lines.text: I'm trying, but she's still too fast!

lines.speaker: helm_op_l
lines.text: Then manually adjust!

lines.speaker: mast_op_r
lines.text: There's no way I can pull that off!
Ziz closes the distance in an instant,
but Laplace and Drake stand between her and us.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Let's go!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: They're going to take her on themselves!
*Boooooom*!
Ziz, diving at high speed, is intercepted by Laplace and Drake.
A massive shockwave ripples outward through the ground.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: Heh... hehe...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: What are you guys? Heretics?

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: We're not Heretics, we're heroes!

lines.speaker: drake
lines.text: No, we're villains!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? Which one is it?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Pierce through!!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh?
*Crrrraackkk*!
Rapi deploys her drill and swings it upward to form an uppercut,
but just before the drill pierces Ziz's side, her wings surge forward to block the attack.
Dark matter splatters everywhere.
Ziz immediately retreats.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wh-what are you guys?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You tricked me! You're nothing but a bunch of scoundrels! But... why are you so strong?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: If I'd known that, I wouldn't have attacked you on my own...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but I'm not scared of you! Don't think otherwise! Not for a second!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I'd have done a lot better if I had some backup!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: It's just that I hate an uneven fight. There's too much to think about when I'm going up against multiple opponents.
*Swoooosh*
Ziz's massive black wings spread out.
Her wingspan is immense, big enough to engulf us all.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: So that's what happened. You scooped us up with those wings of yours, lifted us in the air, and then dropped us.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Haha, not bad, right?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I can even fly. And super fast at that. I'm also really good at finding important things.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: And I'm smart!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I know when to call for backup.
*Splat*
As I adjust my stance, it feels as if I've stepped into something thick and viscous.
As I look downward, I see the entire ground is soaked in Dark Matter.
It must have been from earlier, when Ziz's wings got hit.
*Splurch*
A warmth spreads across my side.
My legs feel wobbly.
I look down again, struggling to keep my vision steady.
Leviathan leaps out of the Dark Matter, cackling and drenched in my blood.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Haha! I did it! It's Vapaus!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: So this is the feeling that Behemoth was talking about.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It feels like every single cell in my body is vibrating!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm not even sure if I can contain all this Dark Matter!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Leviathan!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: But then again,

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: no one's better at controlling Dark Matter than me!
*Bubble bubble bubble*
Dark Matter starts surging out of Leviathan's body.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes, this is it! That's the feeling!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I can do it!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wha... what?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ahahahaha!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Die, traitors!
Bright light bursts forth.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Everyone, brace yourselves! She's going to transform!
